answer: The rule is simple: only a lived past opens the gate. Fishing vessel registration with maritime authority attestation enforces it through a vessel registration number verifiable in the maritime authority register. The whisper of the design is the anchor in the physical world - something a script cannot conjure and a verifier can test without trusting the claimant. A farm must reproduce that anchor a hundred times, and the ridge in each copy is the cost of the real thing, paid in money and in years. The ledge that ends it is the test result: pass and you are in, fail and the door stays shut.
